decisions.reason: Removing navigation from the header does not remove the shared header itself or change the requirement to use common headers and footers across webpages.
The impact is already fully represented by the existing message-44 MODIFY that places site-navigation links in the footer instead of the header.
The source removes header navigation, not the How It Works section, its position, presentation, or content.
The navigation decision does not change the landing page's theme, colors, typography, visual references, or preferred concepts.
Removing header navigation does not change the landing page's responsive-layout rules.
The source does not change which substantive copy is included on the landing page.
The sign-up button remains required and is independent of section links in the header.
The removed navigation belongs to the public landing-page header, while this requirement concerns the separate SaaS console shell and its side-navigation panel.
The location of website navigation does not alter the reusable responsive breakpoint guidance.
Removing header navigation does not change the plain-HTML, Tailwind CSS, or no-Astro implementation choices.
The sign-in branding clause in the same message is independent of the landing-page header-navigation removal.
The source decision does not change any provisioning-wizard visual specification, orientation, or unresolved styling choice.
